boards.hardware: ESP32-S3, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM; SH8501 120x240 AMOLED; ES8311 + ES7210 audio; BQ27220 fuel gauge
boards.identify: Small rectangular AMOLED screen (120x240); three buttons: BOOT, VOL+, VOL-
boards.flash_port: USB-C. Download mode: hold BOOT while plugging in.
boards.use: Muse voice assistant: hold BOOT to talk, the answer is shown as text
boards.notes: Hold VOL- for 6 s to forget the Muse pairing. Chinese text needs a font image in anim_pack (boards/rorolee-muse/font/README.md).
